Curse.title: Curse blocker target never destroyed at battle end
Curse.description: Curse hook sets state.combat.curseTargetStackId on block declaration, but curseTargetStackId is never checked or read anywhere in combat, flow, resolver, SBA, or zones. Curse never destroys the blocker.

True-Curse.title: Timing filter WHEN_DESTROYED discards attack-timed True-Curse
True-Curse.description: True-Curse is an attack ability [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks) [True-Curse]. On unit destruction, registry.getActiveKeywords checks { timing: "WHEN_DESTROYED" }, which mismatches WHEN_ATTACKS and filters out True-Curse. Additionally falls back silently to oppField[0].

Ultra Heavy Armor.title: Ultra Heavy Armor omitted from isArmorFamily continuous check
Ultra Heavy Armor.description: isArmorFamily in isImmune explicitly checks ["Armor", "Heavy Armor", "Ultra Armor", "Silver Wheel", "Barrage"], omitting Ultra Heavy Armor. Cards with Ultra Heavy Armor receive zero immunity.

Wave Crush.title: Wave Crush mechanics cloned from Crush (Cost vs Level, Grave vs Banish, Missing 0 Symbol)
Wave Crush.description: Wave Crush is registered as {...CrushKeyword, id: "Wave Crush"}. In official rules, Wave Crush looks at Cost (not Level), banishes to Removed Zone (not Grave), and fixes Spirit symbol to zero.

XV Crush.title: XV Crush mechanics cloned from Great Crush (Summon vs Attack timing, incorrect milling & destruction)
XV Crush.description: XV Crush is registered as {...GreatCrushKeyword, id: "XV Crush"}. In official rules, XV Crush activates (When Summoned), discards 10 cards, and destroys opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to total cost 15 if any opposing card is banished.

Heaven Holy Life.title: Heaven Holy Life only triggers on attacking spirit instead of any friendly spirit
Heaven Holy Life.description: Heaven Holy Life is registered as {...HolyLifeKeyword}. In official rules, Heaven Holy Life supports all Spirits on field during Your Attack Step when any spirit deals life damage. Registry only checks attacker stack.

Chaotic Holy Life.title: Chaotic Holy Life triggers on damage instead of on block and at battle end
Chaotic Holy Life.description: Chaotic Holy Life is registered as {...HolyLifeKeyword}. In official rules, Chaotic Holy Life recovers life when blocked and at battle end, not on unblocked combat damage.

Dark Assault.title: Dark Assault expects Nexus exhaustion instead of sending 3 cards to Trash
Dark Assault.description: Dark Assault is registered as {...AssaultKeyword}. In official rules, Dark Assault refreshes by sending a total of 3 cards from Hand and decktop to Trash and increases opposing LV cost +3, rather than exhausting a friendly Nexus.

Clash.title: Clash mustBlockIfAble only evaluated by AI heuristic, unenforced in player flow
Clash.description: Clash sets state.combat.mustBlockIfAble = true. However, engine/flow.js and engine/windows.js never enforce this flag during human player block windows. Players can pass without blocking.
